    <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        /* === TOGGLE DROPDOWN MOBILE NAV === */
        var toggles = document.querySelectorAll('.semi21-mobile-bottom-nav .semi21-toggle');

        toggles.forEach(function (btn) {
            btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();

                var parentLi = btn.closest('.semi21-has-dropdown');
                var submenu  = parentLi.querySelector('.semi21-submenu');

                // Tutup semua submenu lain
                document.querySelectorAll('.semi21-submenu').forEach(function (el) {
                    if (el !== submenu) {
                        el.style.display = 'none';
                    }
                });

                // Toggle submenu ini
                if (submenu.style.display === 'block') {
                    submenu.style.display = 'none';
                } else {
                    submenu.style.display = 'block';
                }
            });
        });

        /* === TOGGLE SEARCH PANEL === */
        var searchToggle = document.querySelector('.semi21-mobile-bottom-nav .semi21-search-toggle');
        var searchPanel  = document.querySelector('.semi21-mobile-search-panel');

        if (searchToggle && searchPanel) {
            searchToggle.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();

                // Tutup semua submenu kalau buka search
                document.querySelectorAll('.semi21-submenu').forEach(function (el) {
                    el.style.display = 'none';
                });

                if (searchPanel.style.display === 'block') {
                    searchPanel.style.display = 'none';
                } else {
                    searchPanel.style.display = 'block';
                    var field = searchPanel.querySelector('.semi21-mobile-search-field');
                    if (field) {
                        field.focus();
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        // Klik di luar wrapper => tutup submenu & search
        document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            var wrapper = document.querySelector('.semi21-mobile-bottom-wrapper');
            if (!wrapper) return;

            if (!wrapper.contains(e.target)) {
                document.querySelectorAll('.semi21-submenu').forEach(function (el) {
                    el.style.display = 'none';
                });
                if (searchPanel) {
                    searchPanel.style.display = 'none';
                }
            }
        });
    });
    </script>
 <!-- Close Popup Banner Script -->
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  var popup = document.getElementById('idmuvi-popup');
  
  if (popup) {
    // Close saat klik background gelap
    popup.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (e.target === popup) {
        popup.remove();
      }
    });
    
    // Close saat klik banner (opsional)
    var bannerLinks = popup.querySelectorAll('.banner-content a');
    bannerLinks.forEach(function(link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function() {
        setTimeout(function() {
          popup.remove();
        }, 300); // Delay 300ms biar link sempat terbuka
      });
    });
  }
});
</script>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        /* === TOGGLE DROPDOWN MOBILE NAV === */
        var toggles = document.querySelectorAll('.semi21-mobile-bottom-nav .semi21-toggle');

        toggles.forEach(function (btn) {
            btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();

                var parentLi = btn.closest('.semi21-has-dropdown');
                var submenu  = parentLi.querySelector('.semi21-submenu');

                // Tutup semua submenu lain
                document.querySelectorAll('.semi21-submenu').forEach(function (el) {
                    if (el !== submenu) {
                        el.style.display = 'none';
                    }
                });

                // Toggle submenu ini
                if (submenu.style.display === 'block') {
                    submenu.style.display = 'none';
                } else {
                    submenu.style.display = 'block';
                }
            });
        });

        /* === TOGGLE SEARCH PANEL === */
        var searchToggle = document.querySelector('.semi21-mobile-bottom-nav .semi21-search-toggle');
        var searchPanel  = document.querySelector('.semi21-mobile-search-panel');

        if (searchToggle && searchPanel) {
            searchToggle.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();

                // Tutup semua submenu kalau buka search
                document.querySelectorAll('.semi21-submenu').forEach(function (el) {
                    el.style.display = 'none';
                });

                if (searchPanel.style.display === 'block') {
                    searchPanel.style.display = 'none';
                } else {
                    searchPanel.style.display = 'block';
                    var field = searchPanel.querySelector('.semi21-mobile-search-field');
                    if (field) {
                        field.focus();
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        // Klik di luar wrapper => tutup submenu & search
        document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            var wrapper = document.querySelector('.semi21-mobile-bottom-wrapper');
            if (!wrapper) return;

            if (!wrapper.contains(e.target)) {
                document.querySelectorAll('.semi21-submenu').forEach(function (el) {
                    el.style.display = 'none';
                });
                if (searchPanel) {
                    searchPanel.style.display = 'none';
                }
            }
        });
    });
    </script>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  var popup = document.getElementById('idmuvi-popup');
  
  if (popup) {
    // Close saat klik background gelap
    popup.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (e.target === popup) {
        popup.remove();
      }
    });
    
    // Close saat klik banner (opsional)
    var bannerLinks = popup.querySelectorAll('.banner-content a');
    bannerLinks.forEach(function(link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function() {
        setTimeout(function() {
          popup.remove();
        }, 300); // Delay 300ms biar link sempat terbuka
      });
    });
  }
});
</script>
